players.what: 30-year incumbent in optical link/system-level simulation (VPI Design Suite, transmission/component design, electrical-optical co-simulation with ADS) — the category leader a startup would attack with a cloud-native, AI-augmented alternative

opportunities: Neutral, independent photonic EDA is now a vacuum: within 12 months Lumerical went to Synopsys, RSoft and VPIphotonics to Keysight, and Luceda to a Chinese owner (Semitronix). US hyperscalers, defense primes, and startups wary of vendor lock-in or Chinese ownership have almost no independent, modern, cloud-native option — a software-first startup can be the 'Figma vs Adobe' of photonic design.

PDK-aware AI copilot / agentic design: Flexcompute proved feasibility (June 2026 autonomous loop) but bundles it to its own solver; an open, solver-agnostic agent layer that drives Lumerical/Tidy3D/open-source FDTD, enforces foundry DRC (TSMC COUPE, GF Fotonix, Tower PH18, imec, AIM), and outputs verified tapeout-ready GDS addresses the documented PIC-designer specialization mismatch — sell seats to the 80+ funded photonics startups and to foundry design-enablement teams.

Link-level digital twin for CPO system architects: Keysight paid twice (OSG + VPIphotonics) to assemble E-O-E link simulation, confirming hyperscalers/switch vendors will pay for full-path BER/power/thermal prediction spanning SerDes, optical engine, fiber plant. The incumbents' stack is desktop-era and siloed; a cloud-native, statistically-aware (corner/yield Monte Carlo) CPO link twin with APIs for system architects at Nvidia/Broadcom/Meta-class customers is greenfield.

Test & measurement automation software layer: Teradyne/Quantifi, FormFactor and EXFO sell instruments, but wafer-level photonic test orchestration, known-good-die analytics, and design-to-test feedback (the exact thesis behind Semitronix buying Luceda) has no independent western software vendor; CPO's brutal test economics (light sources, alignment, no rework after co-packaging) make test-time reduction software directly monetizable per wafer.

Inverse-design-as-a-service with fabrication guarantees: academic tooling (MAPS, ADEPT, OptiClear DRC legalization, 1000x AI surrogate speedups) has not been productized; selling verified, foundry-legal inverse-designed blocks (couplers, WDM mux, mode converters) as licensable IP plus a generation API mirrors the ARM/IP business model in a market where every dB and um^2 matters for CPO.

Compact-model and PDK generation automation for foundries: TSMC COUPE, Samsung's 2029 CPO turnkey push, GF Fotonix and new SiN/TFLN foundries (Lightium etc.) all need measured-data-to-compact-model pipelines and PDK QA; foundries are proven software buyers and this is a wedge into the whole design flow.

Ride the gdsfactory open-source ecosystem (2M+ downloads) as distribution: an open-core company offering enterprise verification, AI codegen for gdsfactory PDKs, and cloud simulation orchestration could out-execute DoPlayDo, which remains unfunded and thinly commercialized.

Timing arbitrage on the CPO ramp: Yole puts volume CPO deployment at 2028-2030 ($8.1B market) while Nvidia/TSMC ship first platforms in 2026 — design and simulation software revenue leads hardware volume by 2-3 years, meaning 2026-2027 is precisely when architecture teams staff up and buy tools, before the market looks 'big' to incumbents.
